title: Logo Color Usage / Primary Colorway
slide_intent: Choose the normal color treatment first so exceptional versions do not become the everyday identity.
strategic_value: Frequent orange-and-red signatures can preserve Burger King’s central color equity while adapting to imagery.
demonstration: Three tiles compare the primary logo on Mayo Egg White, on BBQ Brown and backed over a burger photograph.
practical_value: Use the primary colorway for most applications and select its backed version over a full-color photograph.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source connects regulated pairings with consistent brand impression.
reference_purposes.Expression: The primary orange-and-red mark is compared on two solid fields and a photograph.

ingredient.name: Primary logo colorway
ingredient.role: Make the most common signature recognizable across solid and photographic fields.
ingredient.application: Use the primary colorway most often on Mayo Egg White or BBQ Brown; use its background asset over a four-color photo.
ingredient.scope: Historical partner guide; this frequency guidance does not prescribe a numerical usage percentage.
